class.name: ScriptedARInterface
class.brief_description: Advanced deterministic AR fixture replay for desktop tests.
class.description: Load a version-1 PocketAR JSON-lines fixture, call advance_to(0), then assign this interface to a Scripted ARView before adding it to the tree. Time moves only through advance_to(); camera pixels are generated bars. Fixture schema lives in .claude/skills/scripted-sessions/references/fixtures.md in the source repository. Replay/diagnostic methods are outside the stable game API.

method.name: advance_to
method.description: Advances to nonnegative fixture time in microseconds, applying reached records in file order and publishing the newest reached frame. Time cannot move backwards; call with zero before initialization.

method.name: get_pending_inputs
method.description: Drains reached input dictionaries: kind, finger, uv (Vector2), target_frame and session_generation. Returns [code][][/code] when none remain. The driver waits for target_frame to be presented and injects input; the library does not.

method.name: get_plane_count
method.description: Returns the number of current tracking, unsubsumed replay planes.

method.name: get_semantics
method.description: Returns the fixture semantics string, arkit or arcore.

method.name: get_session_state
method.description: Returns the current [enum PocketAR.SessionState]. ARView.session_state is the game facade; notifications are deferred.

method.name: get_tracking_reason
method.description: Returns the current [enum PocketAR.TrackingReason]. NONE alone does not guarantee tracking.

method.name: load_fixture
method.description: Loads and validates the whole UTF-8 JSON-lines fixture. Returns OK on success or a file/parse Error. Malformed records report a line number and preserve the existing fixture. Reload to rewind.

method.name: reset
method.description: Changes generation, clears packets/trackers and keeps the fixture cursor. Planes remain absent until a later frame supplies them again. Does not rewind.

method.name: get_plane_geometry_rebuild_count
method.description: Diagnostic count of polygon storage rebuilds during replay.
